reviews.summary:
Reviewer Zi Yan noted that removing PG_private might cause issues for older makedumpfile versions at crashdump time, and suggested that kdump userspace tools should adapt to this change.

Reviewer noted that removing PG_private might cause issues for older makedumpfile versions at crashdump due to its reliance on VMCOREINFO, and requested input from kdump maintainers and reviewers.
sentiment_signals: need for adaptation by kdump userspace tools
reviews.raw_body:
The expectation is that kdump userspace tools will adapt to this change.
Later, PG_folio will be added to identify folios and has the same value
of PG_private, so preserving PG_private will not work then.

---

Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch removes the PG_private flag from the Linux kernel's page flags, which is a feature that allows private pages to be marked as such. The removal of this flag may cause issues for older versions of makedumpfile, a tool used in kdump, and thus requires input from kdump maintainers and reviewers.
